_note: Supply-voltage limits per device family, used by compliance.check_power_integrity.
Every number here must be read out of the datasheet in this repository and
cited below — an invented absolute maximum is worse than no entry, because
the checker would report a verdict nobody verified.
Devices with no entry get the structural checks only (a supply pin must
reach a supply net), which need no per-device data:
STM32G474 datasheet DS12288 Rev 6, Table 14 footnote 1 — 'All main power
(VDD, VDDA, VBAT) and ground (VSS, VSSA) pins must always be connected to
the external power supply, in the permitted range.'

source.document: STM32G474xB STM32G474xC STM32G474xE datasheet, DS12288 Rev 6

claims.text: VDD - VSS external main supply voltage (including VDD, VDDA, VBAT and VREF+): min -0.3 V, max 4.0 V
VDD standard operating voltage: min 1.71 V, max 3.6 V
